evidence_records.use: Stage-means figure inserted; parent owns figure and data manifest.
evidence_records.boundary: One case, same questions and judges across stages; no claim that more information generally harms accuracy.

evidence_records.source: Buehler, Griffin, and Ross (1994), Study 1, Table 1 and p.369
evidence_records.verified: 37 enrolled; means for 33 completers; best33.9, pessimistic48.6, actual55.5 days. Four unfinished excluded after two semesters.
evidence_records.boundary: Prospective forecasts of one task; no universal completion-time multiplier; pessimistic-vs-actual difference not claimed statistically significant.

evidence_records.source: Milkman, Minson, and Volpp (2014), methods and Table 3 model3
evidence_records.verified: Randomized226, three conditions; gym-only audiobook condition initial adjusted difference0.48 visits,51% relative to estimated0.94 control.
evidence_records.boundary: First-week estimated effect, not full-study average; effect faded, especially around holiday. No claim that all bundling sustains behavior.

evidence_records.verified: Philippine randomized offer; own deposits returned on passing six-month urine test, otherwise charity;11% take-up,3percentage-point offer effect.
evidence_records.boundary: Offer effect includes non-takers; not treatment-on-treated or volunteer-selection comparison. Forfeiture and transfer limits retained.

evidence_records.source: Existing Wegner; Bowen and Marlatt; Breines and Chen; Lyubomirsky and Nolen-Hoeksema; Lally passages
evidence_records.use: Reordered and condensed existing verified study accounts, without adding empirical numbers.
evidence_records.boundary: No equivalence of feeling and action; no universal suppression harm or stress-to-habit mechanism. BRAIN remains a classroom practice.

evidence_records.source: Camerer, Ho, and Chong (2004), Table II, p.875
evidence_records.verified: CEO sample20 mean37.9; game-theorist sample136 mean19.1.
evidence_records.boundary: Selected pools across settings, not randomized expertise; fitted mean is fitting target, not independent validation.

evidence_records.source: Thomas, DeScioli, Haque, and Pinker (2014), Experiment 1
evidence_records.verified: Paid one-shot butcher/baker task; private, secondary, tertiary, common-knowledge instructions; public announcement increased attempts relative to finite shared conditions.
evidence_records.boundary: Described announcement in an experimental scenario; no claim every public communication coordinates action. Study authors explicitly implemented payment pairings appropriate to knowledge conditions.

evidence_records.source: Hong, Morris, Chiu, and Benet-Martínez (2000), Initial Tests, pp.714–715
evidence_records.verified: 303 Hong Kong undergraduates randomly shown American/Chinese icons or geometric controls before interpreting fish picture; Chinese vs American primes increased external attribution.
evidence_records.boundary: Bicultural sample; does not establish fixed national personalities or universal priming effects.

evidence_records.source: Kitayama, Duffy, Kawamura, and Larsen (2003), Study 1
evidence_records.verified: 20 Kyoto Japanese and20 Chicago European American participants; relative and absolute framed-line reproduction; crossover pattern.
evidence_records.boundary: Task comparison, measured cultural groups; nationality/upbringing not randomly assigned and sample small.

evidence_records.source: Gelfand et al. (2011), main text and supplement
evidence_records.verified: Analytic sample6823 in33 nations;12 behaviors rated across15 situations; constraint and threat associations with tightness.
evidence_records.boundary: Not nationally representative; correlational country comparisons do not establish effects of tightening local rules.
